title: K-flat computation of the pinned adjunction on chain maps
statement: Assume derived categories for all schemes [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix g:S-prime to S and the tensor-pullback/direct-image adjunction [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. There exist an additive structure on tensor pullback and, for every K-flat complex P on S [def-pc-kflat-complex], an isomorphism e(P):Q(g-star P) to Lg-star Q(P) [def-pc-derived-pullback], independent of a target or map. For every complex I on S-prime and chain map alpha:P to g-star I, Q of its ordinary termwise transpose equals e(P).hom followed by the inverse pinned derived adjunction homEquiv [def-pc-relative-mv-maps] applied to Q(alpha) followed by schemeMVDirectImageLocalization(g).app(I) [def-pc-mayer-vietoris-image-chain-data]. No boundedness or K-injectivity is required of I.

proof.text: Take the additive structure and left-derived counit from exists_derivedPullbackComposition. Compare it with the K-flat-computing counit from exists_derivedPullback using uniqueness of left-derived functors; therefore it is invertible on P. Transport its inverse through quotientCompQhIso to construct e(P).

Apply the normalized Hom formula of exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction to the homotopy class of the ordinary transpose. The homotopy-category adjunction is induced by the chain adjunction, and its forward transpose is the homotopy class of alpha.

Apply the pinned derived homEquiv to both sides, cancel the invertible comparison, and use naturality of quotientCompQhIso. The transported right-derived unit is exactly schemeMVDirectImageLocalization, proving the required equation.

theorem kFlat_pullback_adjunction_comparison
    [d : ∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {S S' : Scheme.{u}} (g : S' ⟶ S) :
    ∃ (_hL : (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive)
      (e : ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (_ : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := S.sheaf) P),
          (DerivedCategory.Q
              (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace))).obj
              (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≅
            (derivedPullback g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)),
      ∀ (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (hP : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat (R := S.sheaf) P)
        (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
        (α : P ⟶ ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj I),
        (DerivedCategory.Q
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S'.toRingedSpace))).map
            ((((Classical.choose
              (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).mapHomologicalComplex
                (.up ℤ)).homEquiv _ _).symm α) =
          (e P hP).hom ≫ ((relativeMVAdj g).homEquiv _ _).symm
            (DerivedCategory.Q.map α ≫ (schemeMVDirectImageLocalization g).app I)
